facts.fact: The World Bank's implementation status report for the Municipal Performance Program gives the civil registry back-office system as operational in 59 of 97 participating municipalities (reported as 61%), verified by the IGAT; the value was first reported at 30 June 2024 and is unchanged at 30 January 2026. The denominator is the Program's participating municipalities, not all offices, and the report does not say what the system does.
facts.system: back-office system for the civil registry

facts.fact: The World Bank's report records the Municipal Performance Program, which includes the civil registry back-office system among its results, as Program-for-Results financing under an IBRD loan (EUR 192 million disbursed, 71% of the envelope) with AFD co-financing, closing 31 December 2026; it does not state the domestic share.
